summary: KAN-92 profile image upload is already on main (PR #48, commit 3e8b618). The provided diff origin/main...main is empty — no incremental changes — but HEAD meets all eight ACs: upload/update/remove in profile-form, JPG/JPEG/PNG/WEBP + 2MB validation with avatarError, FileReader preview, localStorage persistence via UserService, and avatar display in Header, Sidebar, and Profile. Success feedback is on profile save; upload errors surface immediately. Minor gaps only (empty review diff, MIME-only checks, FileReader test race, no sidebar avatar spec). Repo knowledge (.jarvis-context.md) was not available.

gaps: Provided git diff origin/main...main is empty; KAN-92 is already merged on main (PR #48 / 3e8b618), not in the reviewed diff range.

AC 'Success and error messages are displayed for upload actions' — success is the profile save banner (profile.component.ts:64-68), not a dedicated upload-success toast; errors use avatarError on selection.
AC 'Feature works correctly on desktop and mobile devices' has @media (min-width: 640px) layout breakpoints but no viewport/mobile automated tests.

Data URLs stored in localStorage without magic-byte sniffing beyond client type check.

findings.title: Empty git diff on reviewed branch
findings.detail: origin/main...main produces zero file changes; KAN-92 implementation is already merged on main (PR #48). Review evaluates AC against HEAD, not incremental hunks.

findings.title: No sidebar avatar rendering test
findings.detail: Header spec covers img.avatar-img; sidebar binds profileUser()?.avatar but has no equivalent component spec.

findings.title: MIME-only file type validation
findings.detail: allowedTypes checks file.type only; a non-image with a spoofed MIME could pass client validation.

findings.title: Valid-upload test ignores FileReader async
findings.detail: handles valid image upload asserts previewUrl() immediately after onFileSelected, but preview is set in reader.onload asynchronously.

findings.title: No refresh-persistence integration test
findings.detail: Avatar persistence relies on UserService localStorage; no spec reloads storage to verify post-refresh display.

checklist: All eight KAN-92 ACs addressed on main: upload, update/remove, format validation, error messages, immediate preview, localStorage persistence, Header/Sidebar/Profile display, responsive CSS.
Empty diff noted: feature pre-merged via PR #48; no new changes on origin/main...main.
Run npm install && npm test in CI (per package.json engines) to confirm suite passes.
Optional: add sidebar.component.spec.ts avatar assertion mirroring header test.
Optional: await FileReader in valid-upload unit test; reset file input value after selection.
